1 · First half

How it started.

The Nuggets led 35–24 after one quarter. At the half, the Nuggets led 65–52.

2 · The difference

Murray: 30 points, 17 in the fourth

7 of 8 in the fourth. His fifth 30-point game this season.

3 · How it turned

Up 13 at the half, then held off Memphis’s 38-point third

Murray, Jokić and Johnson combined for 80 of 123.

4 · Where it was won

34 assists and only 6 turnovers

Assists 34–27; points in the paint 54–40. Nine different Nuggets had a block.

5 · Final

Nuggets 123, Grizzlies 118.

From the Grizzlies’ side: Lost the first quarter 24–35, then won the rest of the game 94–88.

What it meant: the Nuggets are 6–4, 9th in the West, with 46% top-6 odds now. The Grizzlies are 7–4, 8th in the West, at 24%.

Johnson from deep.
